frontMatter.title: Fix empty payload crash
frontMatter.purpose: Stop the handler crashing on empty bodies

problemStatement.statement: The handler panics when the request body is empty.
problemStatement.issue: src/handler.go:42 dereferences the decoded payload without checking for nil.
problemStatement.impact: Every empty POST returns a 500 and a stack trace in the logs.

steps.name: Guard the handler
steps.description: Return 400 when the body is empty before decoding.

steps.name: Regression test
steps.description: Add a test that POSTs an empty body and expects 400.

steps.name: Release
steps.description: Ship the fix behind the next patch release.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An empty POST returns 400 with a JSON error
